title: Caddy Access
description: Requests served by Caddy, from its access logs in VictoriaLogs.

list.name: asn
list.label: ASN
list.description: AS number regex, such as 13335 or 13335|15169. Empty matches all.

list.name: step
list.label: Resolution
list.description: Bucket size for time series. auto picks about 60 buckets for the selected range.

list.name: sample
list.label: Latency sampling
list.description: Requests used for latency percentiles. 1/10 keeps requests whose client port ends in 0: p50 and p95 stay within about 1%, p99 is rougher, and queries run several times faster.

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Requests handled by Caddy in the selected range.

targets.expr: {container="caddy"} "handled request" caddy_instance:$instance request.host:$vhost request.proto:$proto status:$status "resp_headers.X-Asn":~"${asn}" | stats count() as requests
{container="caddy"} "handled request" caddy_instance:$instance request.host:$vhost request.proto:$proto status:$status "resp_headers.X-Asn":~"${asn}" | stats count_uniq(request.client_ip) as clients

{container="caddy"} "handled request" caddy_instance:$instance request.host:$vhost request.proto:$proto status:$status "resp_headers.X-Asn":~"${asn}" | stats count() if (status:>=500) as errors, count() as total | math errors / total * 100 as server_errors | fields server_errors

panels.title: Median latency
panels.description: p50 of the time Caddy took to serve a request.

targets.expr: {container="caddy"} "handled request" caddy_instance:$instance request.host:$vhost request.proto:$proto status:$status "resp_headers.X-Asn":~"${asn}" request.remote_port:~"${sample}" | stats quantile(0.5, duration) as p50

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: p95 of the time Caddy took to serve a request.

targets.expr: {container="caddy"} "handled request" caddy_instance:$instance request.host:$vhost request.proto:$proto status:$status "resp_headers.X-Asn":~"${asn}" request.remote_port:~"${sample}" | stats quantile(0.95, duration) as p95
{container="caddy"} "handled request" caddy_instance:$instance request.host:$vhost request.proto:$proto status:$status "resp_headers.X-Asn":~"${asn}" | stats sum(size) as bytes

panels.title: Requests by status
panels.description: Requests over time, split by response status.

targets.expr: {container="caddy"} "handled request" caddy_instance:$instance request.host:$vhost request.proto:$proto status:$status "resp_headers.X-Asn":~"${asn}" | stats by (status) count() as requests

panels.title: Latency
panels.description: Time to serve a request: p50, p95 and p99.

targets.expr: {container="caddy"} "handled request" caddy_instance:$instance request.host:$vhost request.proto:$proto status:$status "resp_headers.X-Asn":~"${asn}" request.remote_port:~"${sample}" | stats quantile(0.5, duration) as p50, quantile(0.95, duration) as p95, quantile(0.99, duration) as p99

panels.title: Requests by host
panels.description: Requests over time per virtual host.

targets.expr: {container="caddy"} "handled request" caddy_instance:$instance request.host:$vhost request.proto:$proto status:$status "resp_headers.X-Asn":~"${asn}" | format if (request.host:"") "(none)" as request.host | stats by (request.host) count() as requests
{container="caddy"} "handled request" caddy_instance:$instance request.host:$vhost request.proto:$proto status:$status "resp_headers.X-Asn":~"${asn}" | stats by (request.method) count() as requests
{container="caddy"} "handled request" caddy_instance:$instance request.host:$vhost request.proto:$proto status:$status "resp_headers.X-Asn":~"${asn}" | stats by (request.proto) count() as requests

panels.title: Requests by upstream
panels.description: Proxied requests per home upstream over time, from the X-Upstream response header.

targets.expr: {container="caddy"} "handled request" caddy_instance:$instance request.host:$vhost request.proto:$proto status:$status "resp_headers.X-Asn":~"${asn}" "resp_headers.X-Upstream":* | extract "[\"<upstream>\"]" from "resp_headers.X-Upstream" | stats by (upstream) count() as requests

panels.title: Upstream share
panels.description: Share of proxied requests per home upstream in the selected range.

targets.expr: {container="caddy"} "handled request" caddy_instance:$instance request.host:$vhost request.proto:$proto status:$status "resp_headers.X-Asn":~"${asn}" "resp_headers.X-Upstream":* | extract "[\"<upstream>\"]" from "resp_headers.X-Upstream" | stats by (upstream) count() as requests

{container="caddy"} "handled request" caddy_instance:$instance request.host:$vhost request.proto:$proto status:$status "resp_headers.X-Asn":~"${asn}" | format if (request.host:"") "(none)" as request.host | extract "<path>?" from request.uri | format if (path:"") "<request.uri>" as path | stats by (request.host, path) count() as requests, sum(size) as bytes | sort by (requests desc) | limit 50

panels.title: Slowest paths
panels.description: Paths with the highest p95 latency, at least 5 requests.

targets.expr: {container="caddy"} "handled request" caddy_instance:$instance request.host:$vhost request.proto:$proto status:$status "resp_headers.X-Asn":~"${asn}" | format if (request.host:"") "(none)" as request.host | extract "<path>?" from request.uri | format if (path:"") "<request.uri>" as path | stats by (request.host, path) count() as requests, quantile(0.95, duration) as p95, max(duration) as max | filter requests:>=5 | sort by (p95 desc) | limit 50

{container="caddy"} "handled request" caddy_instance:$instance request.host:$vhost request.proto:$proto status:$status "resp_headers.X-Asn":~"${asn}" | format if (request.host:"") "(none)" as request.host | status:>=400 | extract "<path>?" from request.uri | format if (path:"") "<request.uri>" as path | stats by (request.host, path, status) count() as requests | sort by (requests desc) | limit 50

{container="caddy"} "handled request" caddy_instance:$instance request.host:$vhost request.proto:$proto status:$status "resp_headers.X-Asn":~"${asn}" | extract "[\"<user_agent>\"]" from "request.headers.User-Agent" | format if (user_agent:"") "(none)" as user_agent | stats by (user_agent) count() as requests, count_uniq(request.client_ip) as clients | sort by (requests desc) | limit 50

panels.title: Top clients
panels.description: Most active client IPs with their country and network.

targets.expr: {container="caddy"} "handled request" caddy_instance:$instance request.host:$vhost request.proto:$proto status:$status "resp_headers.X-Asn":~"${asn}" | extract "[\"<country>\"]" from "resp_headers.X-Country" | extract "[\"<asn>\"]" from "resp_headers.X-Asn" | format if (country:"") "(none)" as country | format if (asn:"") "(none)" as asn | stats by (request.client_ip, country, asn) count() as requests | sort by (requests desc) | limit 50

{container="caddy"} "handled request" caddy_instance:$instance request.host:$vhost request.proto:$proto status:$status "resp_headers.X-Asn":~"${asn}" | extract "[\"<asn>\"]" from "resp_headers.X-Asn" | stats by (asn) count() as requests, count_uniq(request.client_ip) as clients | sort by (requests desc) | limit 50

panels.title: Requests by country
panels.description: Requests per country; circle size and colour follow the request count.

targets.expr: {container="caddy"} "handled request" caddy_instance:$instance request.host:$vhost request.proto:$proto status:$status "resp_headers.X-Asn":~"${asn}" | extract "[\"<country>\"]" from "resp_headers.X-Country" | filter country:!="" | stats by (country) count() as requests

{container="caddy"} "handled request" caddy_instance:$instance request.host:$vhost request.proto:$proto status:$status "resp_headers.X-Asn":~"${asn}" | extract "[\"<country>\"]" from "resp_headers.X-Country" | stats by (country) count() as requests, count_uniq(request.client_ip) as clients | sort by (requests desc) | limit 50

{container="caddy"} "handled request" caddy_instance:$instance request.host:$vhost request.proto:$proto status:$status "resp_headers.X-Asn":~"${asn}" | extract "[\"<country>\"]" from "resp_headers.X-Country" | extract "[\"<state>\"]" from "resp_headers.X-State" | extract "[\"<city>\"]" from "resp_headers.X-City" | stats by (country, state, city) count() as requests | sort by (requests desc) | limit 50
{container="caddy"} "handled request" caddy_instance:$instance request.host:$vhost request.proto:$proto status:$status "resp_headers.X-Asn":~"${asn}" | status:>=500
